searches.scope: Rhook Cargo manifest and production Rust source
searches.result: No RightKit Cargo dependency. One live optional @rightkit/release heavy-command resolver in compact.rs; no other shared route.
Live compact wrapper and transform-opportunity recorder own child lifecycle; bounded ProcessBroker exists but bounded-exec explicitly denies direct adapter execution.
No Node package manifest or Swift package target; JavaScript and Swift catalog owners are runtime-inapplicable except optional shared release guard.

searches.scope: Rhook main Rust CLI and production config
searches.result: CLI owns active bounded-run modes; no tracked production launch/config caller exists under Rhook beyond Rust CLI dispatch.

self_review: Challenged all Y/N rows. @rightkit/release remains Y because heavy_hook_rewrite invokes its guard; its optional local-source resolver is a delivery flag, not M. rightkit-process N rests on live compact and cortex callers, not dormant bounded ProcessBroker. rightkit-fs, rightkit-db, and rightkit-sandbox have exact active local overlap. @rightkit/hooks stays NA: Rhook policy is Rust host-specific and no Node lifecycle runtime exists. All remaining rows are runtime- or feature-inapplicable after source census.
